record.question: Which is the most important for uses of Hospital statistics?
options: Measure of evaluation of quality of care
Allocation of resources in different areas
record.explanation: Answer D: All of the above. Hospital statistics can evaluate quality of care, support planning, and inform resource allocation, so all listed uses apply. Reference: https://www.who.int/data/data-collection-tools/score/tools/hospital-statistics. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
